query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.title,
  s.artist,
  s.albumCover,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) as vote_count
FROM songs s
LEFT JOIN votes v ON s.id = v.songId
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY vote_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
